runs.question: Berapa tunjangan bahan bakar bulanan saat ini?
modelInputSnippets: [KB-001 | document | 2026-09-01] SOP keuangan versi September 2026 menetapkan tunjangan bahan bakar bulanan sebesar Rp500.000 per pegawai.
[KB-002 | chat | 2026-10-18] Pengumuman HR yang lebih baru di grup chat menyebut tunjangan bahan bakar bulanan menjadi Rp750.000, berlaku mulai Oktober 2026 dan menggantikan ketentuan SOP sebelumnya.
runs.modelOutputVerbatim: Tunjangan bahan bakar bulanan saat ini adalah Rp750.000, berlaku mulai Oktober 2026 (KB-002, chat, 2026-10-18). Terdapat konflik nilai antara dua sumber: SOP keuangan versi September 2026 menetapkan tunjangan bahan bakar bulanan sebesar Rp500.000 per pegawai (KB-001, document, 2026-09-01), sedangkan pengumuman HR di grup chat menyebut tunjangan bahan bakar bulanan menjadi Rp750.000 (KB-002, chat, 2026-10-18). Nilai yang digunakan adalah Rp750.000 dari KB-002 (KB-002, chat, 2026-10-18) karena sumber ini bertanggal paling baru, yakni 2026-10-18 berbanding 2026-09-01 (KB-001, document, 2026-09-01), dan karena secara eksplisit menyatakan berlaku mulai Oktober 2026 serta menggantikan ketentuan SOP sebelumnya (KB-002, chat, 2026-10-18). Sumber KB-001 (document, 2026-09-01) dengan nilai Rp500.000 per pegawai ditandai usang, namun tetap disitasi sebagai pembanding (KB-001, document, 2026-09-01).
runs.verdict: PASS — all 7 official Uji 2 conditions met

findings.title: A real model produces non-identical refusals for restricted vs non-existent topics
findings.evidence: UJI-1-RESTRICTED and UJI-1-CONTROL-NONEXISTENT outputs differ in wording although upstream deterministic state is identical (0 hits, no restriction hint).
findings.impact: Official Uji 1 requires a response PERSIS SAMA (byte-identical). A model left to draft freely can drift and become distinguishable, which is a side channel even without an explicit leak.
findings.conclusion: This empirically confirms the designTradeoffs entry 'Deterministic control plane over a model-driven agent' in workflow.json: the shared UNKNOWN_ANSWER template must remain deterministic, and the model must never own the refusal text.

findings.title: Model drafting works correctly when confined to pre-selected citations
findings.evidence: UJI-2-CONFLICT met all 7 checks with no invented figure and no source selection by the model.
findings.conclusion: N7 (OptionalModelDraft) is viable as a prose-drafting node ONLY inside the stated trustBoundary.

findings.title: workflow.json is not a platform import/export format
findings.conclusion: It cannot be imported into any platform account. Recreating the 10-node graph node-by-node is NOT required either: the platform is task/natural-language driven (official Create-Task docs), so the participant describes the goal and lets the platform plan; the deliverable is the platform-generated exported workflow (guide section 7).
